title: Dripay
tagline: Decentralized real-time money streaming on Hedera with payment links and QR codes.
description:
Dripay is a cutting-edge decentralized money streaming platform developed exclusively on the Hedera Hashgraph network. It enables continuous, real-time streaming payments, allowing users to send or receive funds instantly and programmatically over any period, ideal for salaries, subscriptions, vestings and airdrops. Unlike traditional payment systems that require batch processing or delayed transactions, Dripay facilitates seamless and transparent cash flows, reducing friction and unlocking new financial possibilities.
The platform introduces innovative user-friendly features such as generating payment links and QR codes for any streaming transaction. This means that anyone can easily initiate or receive payments without complicated wallet operations or prior setup, making Dripay accessible to both tech-savvy users and the general public.
how_its_made: Dripay is built on Hedera Hashgraph using our solidity smart contracts to handle continuous money streaming securely and efficiently. It leverages Hedera Token Service for managing tokens and the Consensus Service for fast, reliable transaction ordering. The frontend is developed with React.js, communicating with Hedera via the official SDKs to enable users to generate payment links and QR codes easily.
